prose.subject: Invoice INV-41137 - Alder Freight Services
prose.body:
Dear Greywater Robotics,

Please find attached invoice INV-41137 for freight services rendered during the current billing period. The total amount due is 3309.48 USDC. 

Line items are detailed below:
- Standard Freight, Sector 4: 1850.00 USDC
- Priority Handling, Zone B: 950.00 USDC
- Fuel Surcharge (Monthly Avg): 509.48 USDC

Payment is due within 30 days of the issue date. Please remit the total sum to our standard vendor account: alderfreight78.testnet. 

Kindly reference the invoice number in your transfer memo to ensure accurate reconciliation. If you have any questions regarding these charges or require a copy of the delivery manifest, please contact our billing department.

Thank you for your continued business.

Sincerely,
Billing Team
Alder Freight
